front.title: Token-Native Semantic Transport for Real-Time Video Agent Systems

abstract.t: This document describes a token-native semantic transport framework for real-time video agent systems. A client device extracts visual tokens from captured video and transmits their compressed representations to a server for inference. The framework adopts an autoencoder to reduce the dimensionality of visual tokens and organizes the compressed tokens into independently entropy-coded groups to support packet-level adaptation. The client device adjusts the number of visual tokens to transmit, both before and during each frame's transmission, to adapt to changes in available network bandwidth. This document specifies the functional architecture and requirements for token compression, packet-aware grouping, rate adaptation, and server-side token reconstruction.
